name: print-social-chat-bubble-captions-over-product-on-wood
title: Product photo on wood with three chat-bubble captions in pink, blue and cream
whatItIs: A top-down photo of a white stone dish holding a pink squiggle hair claw and a white flower claw on wooden planks. Three iMessage-style speech bubbles in pink, dusty blue and cream stack across the top carrying the caption text.
whatItMeans: Casual, intimate and conversational; the product feels described by a friend.
techniques: Set captions as offset chat bubbles instead of headlines.
Use pastel bubble colours that echo the product.
Keep the photograph unretouched and warm.
Alternate bubbles left and right for a dialogue rhythm.

vocabulary.definition: Text set in message-app speech bubbles.
Bubbles alternating sides like a conversation.
UI colours picked from the product.
A product photographed from directly above.
